verdicts.reason: "Return explicit origin in CORS response when credentials are allowed (#3137)" replaces the `has_cookie` condition in starlette/middleware/cors.py with `self.allow_credentials`, so the cookie-triggered behavior the flagged tests asserted no longer exists; test_cors_allowed_origin_does_not_leak_between_credentialed_requests is renamed to ..._between_requests and keeps its three-request leak check, and test_cors_credentialed_requests_return_specific_origin's oracle moves into test_cors_allow_all (allow_credentials=True), which the same diff changes to assert access-control-allow-origin == "https://example.org" instead of "*".

"Set `Content-Type` instead of `Content-Range` on multi-range responses (#3142)" changes starlette/responses.py to write the multipart boundary into content-type rather than content-range, so the flagged assert in test_file_response_multi_small_chunk_size necessarily changes; the same hunk adds `assert "content-range" not in headers` and `assert headers["content-type"].startswith("multipart/byteranges; boundary=")`, and the sibling range tests gain the same pair — coverage goes up, not down.
